verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents percentage rollouts and gradual-rollout rules that can be ramped and scheduled, including automatic ramp-up release plans. It also documents hashing-based deterministic assignment, so the same attributes always produce the same result across SDKs. Rule changes reach apps through the remotely served SDK payload and real-time streaming, so no redeploy is needed. Missing for 10: explicit docs that users stay in their bucket as a rollout percentage increases (bucketing docs describe experiment and SDK assignment rather than rollout rules), hands-on or independent corroboration of a 1%→100% ramp, and automated ramp schedules are listed only on a higher pricing tier.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying
